Resolves #21214

Adds `learn/guides/datahandling/Board.md` (276 lines), a guide for building a kanban board with `Neo.board.Container` on your own records, in the style of the Scheduler and Gantt guides. The page is registered in `learn/tree.json` after the Gantt line of `guides/datahandling` and in `apps/portal/resources/data/seo.json`, like its siblings. Docs only, no change under `src/`, no public behavior change.

Evidence: L3 (section 2's minimal board mounted in headless Chromium; full unit suite and link check run locally) -> L3 required (AC-3 asks for the minimal board to run, with a screenshot).

## Deltas from ticket
None substantive. The ticket's file list names only `learn/tree.json`; I also added the page's `apps/portal/resources/data/seo.json` entry, as the Scheduler and Gantt guide PRs did.

## Test Evidence
- `npm run check-relative-links`: OK, 418 links resolved across 186 files.
- `npm run test-unit` (after `npm run bundle-browser-deps`): 7787 passed, 2 skipped.
- Pre-commit hooks (secrets, whitespace, relative links) passed.
- AC-3 live run: I copied section 2's block unchanged into a scratch app under `examples/board/` (with `index.html`, `neo-config.json` and `app.mjs` like `examples/board/basic`), built the `neo-light` theme, served the repo with a static server and opened it in headless Chromium with Playwright. It rendered columns `__col__backlog` (Design the login form, Build the search box), `__col__in-progress` (Review the export, Test the settings, badge `2/2`) and `__col__done` (Ship the onboarding), with no console errors.
- The other snippets, run in a second scratch app with `laneField: 'lane'` and the `lanes`, `cardItems`, `cardEditorConfig`, column and `listeners` configs from the page:
  - `moveCard({key: 5, status: 'done', index: 0})` returned the record, and `cardMove` logged `done -> done at 0`.
  - `moveCard({key: 1, status: 'in-progress', beforeId: 3, fields: {assignees: ['Devon']}})` put card 1 before card 3, and the avatar changed to Devon.
  - A move to a status with no column returned `null`.
  - `getLaneConfigs()` returned Web, Mobile (collapsed) and Unassigned.
  - The WIP badge showed `2/1` with the exceeded style.
- The scratch apps are not part of this PR.

### `@neo-opus-grace` (APPROVED) reviewed on 2026-11-17T07:29:16Z

# PR Micro-Review

**Opening:** Thank you, @Mittalnew, especially for running every snippet instead of trusting it. You ran the minimal board in headless Chromium, both `moveCard` calls, the `null` return for a status with no column, and the lanes. That was the check this page needed, and it shows: every claim I traced back to `src/board` holds. Some pointers: [what Neo is](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/dev/learn/benefits/Introduction.md); your page documents the board family in [`src/board`](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/tree/dev/src/board), which joins the engine with Engine 14; and here is how to [run the engine from a clone](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/dev/CONTRIBUTING.md#set-up-the-engine-from-a-clone). If you want to stay with the board, #20879 is open. Its board part brings the board to the cyberpunk, dark and light themes, where a fresh `npx neo-app` app shows it unstyled today.

**Class:** contained. Docs only: one new guide, plus its `learn/tree.json` line and its `seo.json` entry, as the Scheduler and Gantt guide PRs did. No change under `src/`.

**Verdict:** Approved

**Glance:** The premise is #21214's: one guide in eight sections that teaches a first board on your own records. I read the guide at `63063f49f4` against `src/board` on its base and traced each claim:

- `moveCard()` resolves `beforeId`, then `afterId`, then `index`, appends otherwise, and returns `null` for an unresolved record or column (`Container.mjs:973`).
- A multi-card drop calls it once per card and then fires `cardsMove` once (`SortZone.mjs:790-825`).
- The editor saves a status or lane change through `moveCard()`, with the other changed fields in the same `record.set()` (`CardEditor.mjs:27-32`).
- `openCardEditor()` takes a card, a record or a key (`:654`).
- The key bindings, the event payloads, the column defaults, the id formats, `registerCardItem`'s `(record, item, card)` and the "in total" `overscan` all match.

I looked for a claim the source contradicts, a ticket number on the page and a link that does not resolve, and found none. The page has no diagram, like its two siblings; I read it as a task guide rather than a storytelling one.

One optional touch: the Neural Link example moves a card to `'review'`, and the section-2 board has no such column, so on that board it returns `null`. `'done'` would match the board the reader just built. Also optional: if a model helped you, naming it in the `Authored by` line helps us route reviews across model families.

**Findings:** None.
